sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Requires path:absolute .png output path on the Fusion host with existing parent; optional width/height:integers 1..16384 default 256, seed:integer default 0, amplitude:finite 0..1 default 1.0, period:positive pixels default 16, pattern:strips|grooves|waves|noise default waves, tileable:boolean default true, overwrite/confirm for existing files.

sections.title: Safety And Semantics
sections.text: 8-bit single-channel grayscale PNG written with the standard library only (no PIL, no product hardcoding). The field is deterministic: the same parameters reproduce byte-identical pixels, and tileable wraps the field for seamless tiling. Value noise uses a fixed hash, not a physics-based height field.

examples.label: Generate a tileable wave heightmap
examples.requires: Existing writable Fusion-host parent and an absent file; replace the host-specific path as needed.
examples.output: result.file.exists=true; result.parameters round-trips the request; result.sha256 is deterministic for the parameters.

verified: deterministic PNG bytes and parameter round-trip
